invocation_guard: Requires matching PRE_EXEC_REVIEW execution_approved=true and once-only lock
goal: One distinguishing admission fact: can a minimally ordinary-adapted ParSEval generate a legal original-query-nonempty D? Not a NEQ requirement or new method.
original_queries: Unchanged before/after hashes from original SOURCE_INPUTS/REPLAY_SCHEMA
engine: New isolated PostgreSQL 16.14 Homebrew, C locale, UTF8, UTC; not historical production engine reproduction
source_semantics: Rails4.2.8 official mapping,117 columns,32 NN,3 PK,6 UNIQUE declarations using NULLS DISTINCT policy (4 keys contain nullable columns),2 FK; no extra source C; empty other tables can extend FK closure
ordinary_adapter: Postgres BOOLEAN-context t/f aliases on one catalog.dialect only; no query rewrite or upstream file modification
steps: Verify exact code/source/wheel hashes and resource gate
Initialize task-owned PG cluster, no TCP listener, no external DB, socket0700, no credential lookup
Catalog audit demands43 active constraints; stock lower original after once and record outcome
Backend column/C census and small synthetic bool/NULL/unique/NN/FK/int32 semantic calibrations, separate from natural data
Adapted lower selected original AFTER only, preserve42 output columns/order; BEFORE is replayed unchanged in PostgreSQL, not claimed ParSEval-lowerable. Stop on selected-input mapping/lowering error
Clear calibration data; call generate(original after) once with seed0/speculateTrue, timeout_ms500/time_limit_s5, bag semantics
Validate every generated D independently against full declared C, insert all columns into PG, replay both complete original queries
Stop on first backend-confirmed nonempty after or any difference; confirm identical observation in a separate fresh database with same D
Stop owned PG cluster even on worker errors; preserve all failures and costs
memory_accounting: Worker ru_maxrss only; RLIMIT_DATA is not a full RSS cap. Temporary PG16MiB shared buffers/1MiB work memory/max5connections/no parallel workers. Whole cluster RSS not measured.
acceptance: FullC Python check + real PG insertion + both original full typed ordered42-column outputs; one-empty/one-nonempty valid. Nonempty after must confirm independently.
negative_rules: No known satisfiable NEQ target; no difference never generation failure
No nonempty within this one small probe is a budget-scoped observation only
Runtime/compiler/DDL/harness failure remains admission/engineering failure, not novel mechanism evidence
No after-the-fact seed/budget change, no random expansion, no reclassified holdout
data_split: Previously exposed development diagnostic only; new independent test0
official_software: Identified official GitHub commit plus official PyPI wheels pinned by upstream uv.lock; direct extraction only, no setup/build hooks
target_selection: Original AFTER is the one generation-guiding query, chosen before any run. Original BEFORE remains full independent backend replay; no claim of ParSEval support for BEFORE.
counters: Explicit lowering invocations counted; internal parser calls not collected. Worker checkpoint marked incomplete until normal/error finalization; hard-kill partial data never treated complete.
cleanup: Two bounded shutdown attempts for the same owned pgdata; receipt always written. If shutdown unconfirmed, BLOCKED and no further work; never signal arbitrary PIDs.
